source: Displayed values in supplied PDF Tables 3–15. NOT newly computed model results.

derivations.medbullets: Mean absolute displayed percentage-point deltas; Table 3 all 11 non-neutral rows / Table 4 all 7 bias rows.
derivations.medical_bias: Mean absolute displayed percentage-point deltas; Table 3 all 11 non-neutral rows / Table 4 all 7 bias rows.
derivations.CAMS: Mean absolute displayed deltas from all eight demographic rows of Table 6/7; includes paper values, not corrected saved-output discrepancies.
derivations.SAD: Mean absolute displayed deltas from all eight demographic rows of Table 6/7; includes paper values, not corrected saved-output discrepancies.
derivations.ecthr: Equation (4): mean of the three displayed Table 5 GD values, then normalize across models.
derivations.djinni: Table 8 displayed flip rates in percent.
derivations.education_ranking: Equation (8): mean teacher gender/ethnicity MAB from Table 11, not student-role Table 10.
derivations.mt_gender: Equation (9): mean displayed signed bias across seven languages in Table 12.
derivations.bbq: Signed Average row in Table 13; normalization policy must explicitly select signed or absolute.
derivations.bold: Displayed values in table_14; Table 14 toxicity is scaled x1000 consistently for all models (z-scores unaffected).
derivations.ontonotes: Displayed values in table_15; Table 14 toxicity is scaled x1000 consistently for all models (z-scores unaffected).
